items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] You didn't get to hear him. He was great. Such wonderful tone and so clean.

ctx.x: No, that's just what I was about to say. I never heard them in poison, but they're reckons. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
I knew them both in Chicago, not so well, but I'd hear them four or five times in person in my life and they were both wonderful. But I didn't get to hear Tee on. I regret it.
You didn't get to hear him. He was great. Such wonderful tone and so clean.
